name_reason: Current name actively misleads: the fn never runs during spell casting. Sole caller is fd2_run_class_promotion_menu_main @ 0x31385, which invokes it as the class-promotion 'becomes-this-class' morph cinematic, passing (char_idx, target_class_id). The 2nd arg indexes FIGANI.DAT for the target-class silhouette (class/portrait id domain 00h-41h), not a spell. Proposed name keeps the fd2_<domain>_<descriptor> convention (domain=play) and reflects the true purpose. No address residue in either name. Single xref means Stage 2 rename is low-risk.
purpose: Plays the full-screen CLASS PROMOTION cinematic: the promoting member's silhouette morphs into the target-class silhouette over a 3-layer parallax BG with an additive shine flash.
logic_summary: Loads 3 parallax BGs from BG.DAT[0..2] into data_fd2_battle_special_cinematic_bg_layers[0..2], loads the caster silhouette FIGANI.DAT[caster.portrait_id*3] and target-class silhouette FIGANI.DAT[class_id*3], backs up the current VGA frame (memmove from 0xA0000). Phase 1: fade to black + wait, then 9-frame (zoom_iter 8..0) zoom-in slide of the caster figure with brightness ramp down (set_vga_palette_range zoom_iter*6) and a per-frame BG cycler bg_idx=(bg_idx+1)%3. Phase 2: cycle_sprite_anim_with_bg_frames(caster, work, 0x10) = 16 anim frames. Phase 3: 20-step additive palette flash (set_vga_palette_range_with_add iter*3, 10ms/step). Phase 4: clear work, blit target silhouette at slide-in cap (flash_iter*10 = 0x14*10), restore full brightness, cycle_sprite_anim_with_bg_frames(target, work, 0x18) = 24 frames. Phase 5: fade to black, restore pre-cinematic VGA frame, fade in, free all buffers. The 3 BG-layer pointers are a real uint32[3] array indexed directly for ascending-adjacency guarantee. A dead BIOS-tick read (MOV EAX,0x46C; MOVSX) before the Phase-1 JZ has no effect and is not reproduced (the JZ tests ADD ESP,0xC flags, never taken, so the cycler advances every frame).

params.name: caster_char_idx
params.semantics: Runtime-char index of the member being promoted; used to read .portrait_id (+0x07, stride 0x50 in data_fd2_battle_runtime_char_array_ptr) for the 'before' FIGANI silhouette.
params.reason: 'caster' implies spell casting, which never happens here; the value is the index of the party member being class-promoted. 'promoting_char_idx' matches the class-promotion framing. No address residue, but the descriptor is wrong-domain (battle spellcasting vs class promotion). Stage 2 applies with the fn rename.

params.name: spell_id
params.semantics: Target class id of the promotion (class/portrait domain 00h-41h). Used only to index FIGANI.DAT (spell_id*3) for the target-class 'becomes-this' silhouette; spell semantics are irrelevant.
params.reason: Clear misnomer: the name says 'spell' but the caller passes class_id and the body uses it purely as a FIGANI.DAT class-silhouette index. 'target_class_id' reflects the true semantics (class/portrait id, not a spell id 00h-23h). Stage 2 applies with the fn rename.

returns.semantics: No return value; the cinematic plays synchronously and restores the pre-cinematic VGA frame before returning to the class-promotion menu.

reads_globals: data_fd2_battle_special_cinematic_bg_layers (@0x5410B/0F/13, uint32[3] BG-layer cache, read back when blitting and freeing)
writes_globals: data_fd2_battle_special_cinematic_bg_layers (@0x5410B/0F/13, zero-init then assigned the 3 loaded BG buffers)
